name: anonymous-pricing
description: Who's been caught charging different people different prices, what to do before you pay, and your rights by state.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-checker.mjs && node scripts/copy-ocr.mjs && node scripts/build-extension.mjs
scripts.api:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.api:deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c worker/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
